content.concept_description: A neon lion maze puzzle challenge where the player tries to untangle directional arrows, but fails continuously and watches their IQ score drop.
content.cultural_reference: Albert Einstein avatar representing IQ measurement
content.why_it_works: The dropping IQ meter and red flashing failure effects trigger ego threat and urge viewers to download the game to prove they can solve the puzzle correctly.

visuals.primary_color: black #000000, neon cyan #00E5FF, neon magenta #FF007F, neon orange #FF8C00
visuals.notable_objects: Lion neon maze, hand cursor, FAIL button

emotions.emotional_arc: Intrigue at neon lion art -> increasing frustration and tension as wrong moves make the IQ drop to failure

end_card.cta_and_text: 00:58 - 'PLAY NOW!' on CTA button, 'ARROW OUT' logo text

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Tapping arrows to slide them out of an intricate maze without colliding into other arrows.

chapterization.chapter_description: Animated neon lion roars and transforms into a circuit-like arrow maze profile.
A hand cursor begins tapping arrows around the lion's face, making some successful moves and some errors.
Camera zooms and shifts across the lion body as repeated mistakes cause the IQ meter to steadily decline from 85 down to 15.
A large red 'FAIL' stamp pops up over the game screen with a failure buzzer.
End card appears showing the Arrow Out app icon, game logo, and Play Now button.

_evidence.hook_trigger:Novelty: 00:00 - Glowing neon animated roaring lion morphing into an arrow circuit puzzle.
_evidence.hook_emotion:Curiosity: 00:00 - Glowing neon aesthetic and lion roaring animation draws immediate curiosity.
_evidence.persuasion_triggers:Challenge / Ego Thre: 00:07 - 'Your IQ' bar decreases with each wrong move, challenging the player's intelligence.
_evidence.ad_emotion:Frustration: 00:09 - Screen flashes red and buzzer sounds as IQ drops from wrong choices.
_evidence.ad_emotion:Tension: 00:47 - Screen continues to flash red as IQ plummets to 20, building tension.
_evidence.gameplay_moment_type:Puzzle Solving: 00:05 - Hand taps arrows trying to clear paths from the lion outline.
_evidence.gameplay_moment_type:Trial & Error: 00:08 - Hand attempts tapping blocked arrows, testing which arrows can exit.
_evidence.gameplay_moment_type:Failure: 00:56 - Big red FAIL stamp appears on screen after repeated wrong moves.
_evidence.ad_format: Rule 4 applied: Real arrow untangling puzzle mechanics paired with an IQ meter, Einstein avatar, animated CGI intro, and FAIL stamp overlay.
